study.title: Connectivity Study of the Neuromechanism of Acute Acupuncture Needling during fMRI in "Overweight" Subjects
study.study_design: Randomized controlled trial; two-group parallel design with fMRI during intervention
study.randomization: Subjects were randomly assigned by a computer program to groups A and B
study.blinding: The acupuncturist was the only nonblinded individual in the research group; lower legs were covered to mask the treatment choice
study.population: right-handed volunteer Chinese males aged 21–45 years with a body mass index (BMI) >18 and <30
study.disease_condition: overweight (BMI >18 and <30, higher WHR >0.9); classified as overweight/unfit
study.inclusion_criteria: right-handed volunteer Chinese males aged 21–45 years, BMI >18 and <30, no history of major neurologic and psychiatric disease, acupuncture naïve, abstaining from eating 12 hrs prior to scanning
study.exclusion_criteria: athletic or fit physique, waist-to-hip ratio (WHR) <0.9, smokers, being on a weight-loss program, claustrophobic, not abstaining from eating 12 hrs prior to scanning, being on antidepressants and/or appetite suppressing medications

arms.arm_label_exact: Group B – minimal sham acupuncture treatment (min SHAM)

conditions.scan_context: Pre-stimulation baseline measurements (CBT, GLU, hunger survey)

conditions.condition_label_exact: Prescan (5 min before needles inserted) – min SHAM
conditions.scan_context: Pre-stimulation baseline measurements (CBT, GLU, hunger survey)
conditions.tissue_level_reasoning: Described as superficial insertion only with immediate removal. No retention and no deep penetration to muscle or fascia. Engages cutaneous fibers only, consistent with Level 2 (1–5mm skin-level penetration). The immediate removal further confirms no sustained deep tissue engagement.

conditions.condition_label_exact: During ACU – 21 min scan with needles in
conditions.timepoint_exact: 0–21 min (needles inserted at 0 min, needle rotation at 1–3 min, scan continues to 21 min)
conditions.scan_context: fMRI acquisition during acupuncture; 8.5 min of normalized data extracted after omitting first 0.5 min

conditions.condition_label_exact: During min SHAM – 21 min scan with pretend needle rotation
conditions.timepoint_exact: 0–21 min (needles inserted superficially and immediately removed; acupuncturist pretended to rotate)
conditions.scan_context: fMRI acquisition during minimal sham acupuncture
conditions.tissue_level_reasoning: Same physical procedure as the prescan condition: superficial insertion immediately removed at non-acupoints. No depth into muscle or fascia. Pretend rotation is performed but needles are already removed, so only cutaneous-level tissue engagement occurred at insertion. Level 2 applies.

conditions.timepoint_exact: 9 min postscan (after 21 min scan + 7 min anatomical scan)
conditions.scan_context: Post-stimulation measurements (CBT, GLU, hunger survey, De-qi sensations)

conditions.condition_label_exact: Postscan – 9 min postscan after min SHAM
conditions.timepoint_exact: 9 min postscan (after 21 min scan + 7 min anatomical scan)
conditions.tissue_level_reasoning: Identical sham procedure to the other two conditions — superficial insertion with immediate removal at non-acupoints. Physical depth is limited to skin level only, engaging cutaneous Aβ/Aδ fibers without reaching muscle or fascia. Classified as Level 2.

interventions.procedure_label_exact: Manual acupuncture at ST 36 and SP 9 bilaterally
interventions.anatomical_location_exact: ST 36 is 3 cun below ST 35 (Du Bi), which is in the depression lateral to the patellar ligament on the lower border of the patella when the knee is flexed and 1 cun lateral to the anterior crest of the tibia; SP 9: when the knee is flexed, located along the posterior border of the upper tibia
interventions.penetration_exact: inserted vertically to a depth of 2-3 cm
interventions.manipulation_exact: rotated in a 'tonifying and reducing' technique clockwise and counterclockwise at a rate of 60 times per minute (2 Hz) in an alternating bilateral diagonal manner at 30 sec intervals for a total of 2 min
interventions.deqi_intended_exact: Subject was allowed to raise his right index finger if the De-qi sensations were painful; De-qi sensations evaluated post-stimulation on a standard Likert scale (0 being no sensation and 10 being the most intense sensation felt)
interventions.session_duration_exact: 21 min scan with needles in, plus prescan and postscan periods
interventions.participant_instructions_exact: Subject was allowed to raise his right index finger if the De-qi sensations were painful; lower legs were covered to mask the treatment choice
interventions.treatment_rationale_given_exact: ST 36 and SP 9 selected as acupoints relevant to obesity/overweight treatment; acupoints affecting energy and feeding mechanisms

interventions.procedure_label_exact: Minimal sham acupuncture (min SHAM) at sham acupoints bilaterally
non_acupoint_locations_exact: 2 cun lateral and dorsal to ST 36 bilaterally
2 cun medial to SP 9 on the same plane bilaterally
interventions.anatomical_location_exact: SHAM acupoints located 2 cun lateral and dorsal to ST 36 and 2 cun medial to SP 9 on the same plane bilaterally
interventions.manipulation_exact: acupuncturist pretended to rotate needles as described for ACU procedure; no actual needle rotation performed
interventions.needle_retention_exact: needles immediately removed after superficial insertion; pretend procedure continued for remainder of 21 min scan
interventions.session_duration_exact: 21 min scan with pretend procedure, plus prescan and postscan periods
interventions.participant_instructions_exact: lower legs were covered to mask the treatment choice

sham_details.sham_subtype_exact: minimal sham acupuncture – superficial needle insertion at non-acupoints with immediate removal and pretend rotation
sham_details.sham_location_exact: 2 cun lateral and dorsal to ST 36; 2 cun medial to SP 9 on the same plane bilaterally
sham_details.sham_manipulation_exact: acupuncturist pretended to rotate needles as described for ACU procedure
sham_details.sham_credibility_procedure_exact: Subjects were asked if they thought they received real or sham acupuncture

sensory_interoceptive_responses.timepoint_exact: After 21 min scan (post-stimulation, during postscan period)
sensory_interoceptive_responses.item_or_subscale_exact: De-qi sensations (0 being no sensation and 10 being the most intense sensation felt)
sensory_interoceptive_responses.notes: Paper states De-qi was measured on a Likert scale 0–10 but numerical results are not reported in the text; De-qi sensations named but individual subscale values not provided

sensory_interoceptive_responses.item_or_subscale_exact: Subject was allowed to raise his right index finger if the De-qi sensations were painful
sensory_interoceptive_responses.notes: Pain response monitored via finger-raise signal; no quantitative pain data reported

neuroimaging_methods.scanner_manufacturer_model_exact: 3.0 Tesla Signa (GE) MRI scanner with a standard head coil
neuroimaging_methods.voxel_size_exact: 3.75 mm × 3.75 mm in-plane resolution; 5 mm slice thickness with no gaps; resampled to 3 mm × 3 mm × 3 mm
neuroimaging_methods.scan_duration_exact: 21 min (functional scan); first 5 time points discarded; first 0.5 min of data omitted; 8.5 min of ACU normalized data extracted
neuroimaging_methods.coordinate_space_reported_exact: Talairach coordinates (mentioned for ROI selection); MNI template used for normalization
neuroimaging_methods.smoothing_exact: 12 mm full-width at half maximum (FWHM) Gaussian kernel (for DCT analysis)
neuroimaging_methods.motion_exclusion_exact: If translation and rotation was >1 mm in any direction or >1 degree, the subject was excluded
neuroimaging_methods.filtering_exact: discrete cosine basis set contained 60 regressors spanning the frequency of 0–0.1 Hz; F-contrasts compared signal fluctuations in range 0.01–0.1 Hz
neuroimaging_methods.global_signal_regression_exact: regressing out the effects of head motion parameters and signals from a region centered in the white matter and a region centered in the cerebrospinal fluid
primary_neuroimaging_metrics: Pearson correlation (between FC change and physiological outcome change)
statistical_thresholds_exact: P < 0.005 (corrected for multiple comparisons) at the first level (DCT analysis)
P < 0.005 (uncorrected) with cluster size >3 voxels (SCA second-level two-sample t-test)
P < 0.05 (Pearson correlation analysis; noted: a lower P value could not be used to detect any regions)
neuroimaging_methods.multiple_comparison_correction_exact: corrected for multiple comparisons at first level (DCT); uncorrected at P < 0.005 with cluster size >3 voxels for SCA

extraction_notes.note: No coordinate triplets (x, y, z) are provided in Tables 1–3. All table rows list only brain region name, activation direction, side, P value, and T value. Coordinate-based neuroimaging synthesis is not possible from this paper.

Numerical values for CBT, GLU, and hunger at each timepoint are not reported in this paper. The paper states these are reported in the companion paper: von Deneen et al. (2011), Medical Acupuncture, reference [40]. Only delta values (change scores) are implicitly used in the Pearson correlation analyses.

The paper states 'epoch of treatment lasted 9 min' in Figure 2 caption, but the methods state the scan was 21 min with needles in. The 9 min likely refers to the active stimulation epoch extracted or a specific analysis window; it is unclear which exact data segment was analyzed for functional connectivity.

The paper states 'first 0.5 min of data was omitted and 8.5 min of the ACU normalized data were extracted' but Figure captions refer to 'epoch of treatment lasted 9 min.' These are slightly inconsistent; 8.5 min vs 9 min.

The coordinate space is ambiguous. The methods mention Talairach coordinates for ROI selection but normalization was done to MNI template. It is unclear whether reported results are in Talairach or MNI space.
De-qi sensations were assessed on a Likert scale 0–10 post-stimulation, but individual subscale values or summary scores are not reported in this paper.
Adverse events are not mentioned anywhere in the paper.
No trial registration number is provided.
Blinding success results (whether subjects correctly guessed their allocation) are not reported quantitatively. Only a statement that subjects were asked is provided.
Expectancy and credibility were not formally assessed with validated instruments.
Table 4 lists 'T value = 2.989' for LEFT AMY (likely a typographic error vs. 2.898 used everywhere else). Extracted exactly as reported.

The paper does not provide pre/post individual or group mean physiological values in this publication. The Pearson correlation analysis used delta values (post minus pre), but exact magnitudes of change are referenced only indirectly.

The paper does not report baseline between-group comparisons of demographic or physiological variables (age, BMI, WHR, CBT, GLU, hunger) in a formal table in this paper; these are referenced to the previous study [40].

The paper refers to the needle rotation technique as 'tonifying and reducing' at 2 Hz for 2 min, but also says 'at 30 sec intervals.' It is unclear whether rotation was continuous or intermittent at 30-second intervals.

The figure captions for Figures 2 and 3 describe overlapping areas (putamen, insula, parahippocampus, hippocampus, amygdala, ACC, thalamus, pons for HYP; putamen, insula, parahippocampus, hippocampus, hypothalamus, cerebellum for AMY) but these overlap regions do not exactly match Table 1 entries for all regions. The conjunction analysis appears to define the ROI masks used for further SCA, not the SCA results themselves.
